settings.headline: About Carrow Bend Water
settings.subtitle: A fictional special district on the fictional Ossel River, created to show what a local water utility website needs to do well.

settings.headline: The system in the story
settings.body: One river intake, a 2.1 MGD treatment plant (story), two wells for peak days, three elevated tanks, and 112 miles of main. The oldest cast-iron segment downtown dates to 1962 in the story — which is why planned-work alerts cluster there.
settings.side: Office: 1 Reservoir Lane, Carrow Bend · Mon–Fri 8–5 · office@carrowbend.example — that address does not reach anyone. Nothing on this site collects real customer data.
